verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint for listing the live catalog. It shows OpenAI compatibility via a base-URL swap, a published OpenAPI spec, and a chat-completions reference, but none of these explicitly covers model enumeration. Agent skills that teach 'right model IDs' and a docs MCP server are adjacent features, not a programmatic live catalog listing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
